page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge is an enterprise-grade virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with 104 dedicated vCPUs driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, accompanied by 384.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU, providing balanced processing capacity and substantial aggregate memory across a high core count.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of remote block storage volumes for persistent data operations. Networking capabilities include a baseline throughput of 25 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default. The platform contains no discrete graphics processing hardware, focusing hardware allocation purely on general-purpose and memory-centric CPU compute.

Hardware resource density allows the instance to manage extensive concurrent execution threads efficiently without per-core resource oversubscription. Given the large scale of 104 dedicated vCPUs, 384.0 GB RAM, and a 25 Gbps network interface, Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge is well positioned for enterprise web serving tiers, distributed caching, enterprise database deployments, and large-scale continuous integration or batch processing workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge is a dedicated virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor on the x86_64 architecture. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, the platform provides 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation ratio of 3.69 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is not equipped with local storage disks, requiring external cloud storage infrastructure for persistence, and it contains no GPU accelerators. Baseline network capacity is configured at 25 Gbps, supporting stable throughput for data transport. With dedicated compute execution and large aggregate system capacity, resource efficiency is concentrated on high-concurrency CPU tasks rather than local storage operations. Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge fits high-demand workloads including relational and in-memory databases, large-scale web application serving, batch processing pipelines, and enterprise application deployments.
